_comment: First-run onboarding: the short path through a new character's first ten minutes. Steps are ordered by `order` and retire the moment their own `condition` is already true against live state — there is no claim step and no dismissal. Condition kinds: skill_level, have_item, kill_monster, do_actions (skill_id+action_id narrows it; omit both to count every action), gp_total, quests_claimed. Every counter read here is one the game already keeps, so the guide can never disagree with the save. `route` uses the Screens vocabulary: a screen id plus optionally skill_id / action_id / area_id.

first_firewood.title: Fall your first tree
first_firewood.body: The survey stakes are in and the hearth is cold. Timbercraft is open to you from the first minute — pick Emberpine Tree and let a handful come down before you decide anything else.

first_bar.title: Smelt a bar
first_bar.body: Copper and tin, one of each, and out comes something worth building with. Delving and Forgecraft are the two halves of the first real chain in the game.

first_weapon.title: Forge a weapon
first_weapon.body: Holding a blade you made yourself is the difference between a settler and a resident. Anything you craft can be worn straight out of your stores.

first_fight.title: Win a fight
first_fight.body: Combat runs itself once you commit, and the fields past Hearthfall are full of fowl that barely scratches. Wear the scimitar, walk into the Farmlands, and let it play out.

first_gold.title: Earn 1,000 gold
first_gold.body: Gold buys permanent upgrades in the Provisioner and cheap stock in the General Store. Neither is much use until a run of it is behind you.

timbercraft_five.title: Reach Timbercraft 5
timbercraft_five.body: Levels, not items, open new activities. Keep felling and the bar fills on its own; the Ironbark Tree waiting at 10 is the first one that costs you thought.

first_task.title: Claim a task
first_task.body: There are hundreds of them and they pay on claim rather than on completion. The easy ones are written for exactly where you are standing now.
first_task.completion_note: That is the shape of it: gather, craft, fight, then come back to the Overview and follow what it suggests next.
